items.title: Alvin Alcorn Interview, 1976-01-25
items.q: We was coming from different areas. Because we had taken a break. The band was off for a while... And Norrie came through here on the plane. I mean on a train. I went to New York with his family. And we all was on the same ship called SS Flammers.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. He never returned to New Orleans. Not to live.

Or it came through here in 1956. He was going to Europe. And Or it came by train from here to New York. He wouldn't ride the plane. He didn't get much for planes. He had to ride the plane later. So he came through here with his family. And he didn't get off the train. That's what I understand. This train went on New York. When I got to New York, I flew from here to New York. To go meet the ship. We went up on the SS plan. We was coming from different areas. Because we had taken a break. The band was off for a…
And when was this? 1956. 1956. First trip he made over there.
